The '''GR-14 XT Plasma Core Blaster''' was a model of plasma [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The GR-14 XT Plasma Core Blaster was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Wild Space Explorer's Pack, which was released to the Cartel Market on [[September 1]], [[2015]].
